text:
In garden’s hush, the wild winds speak,
To ears that seek the truth they seek.
The flowers bloom with silent vow,
Unfurling grace to show the bough.

The trees stand guard, ancient and still,
Their leaves whisper of ages’ will.
A green retreat, a sacred space,
Where time and nature find their place.

Here solace grows in simple ways,
Through life’s eternal, turning days.
Each petal’s rise, each leaf’s decline,
Reveals the path of time’s design.

The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.
